compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Eighteen developer-tooling files contain repeated, obvious, stale, or historical prose identified by the comment audit and revalidated on `origin/main` at `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`. Shortening it must preserve each gate's current failure posture and operator-facing help.

## Approach
Edit only comments/docstrings and blank lines in the declared files. Preserve non-docstring AST, shell behavior, test assertions, shebangs, and exact tool/policy directives. Keep user-facing help complete while removing history and duplication.

## Scope
- `scripts/check_import_walk.py` — Remove volatile module counts; preserve both all-failure legs, isolated script imports, and exact reasoned-skip rules. Argparse consumes its first docstring line.
- `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py` — Remove volatile tool counts; preserve correspondence, normalization, divergence, coherence, and stand-in recovery contracts. Argparse consumes its first docstring line.
- `scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py` — Preserve the seven-kind partition, qualified names, exact nonblank reasoned markers, shrink-only/update behavior, and exit semantics. Its full module docstring is argparse help.
- `scripts/check_orphaned_load.py` — Preserve the PPID-plus-CPU signal, exclusions, threshold basis, and read-only/on-demand behavior.
- `scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py` — Preserve R1/R2/R3 and workflow rules, fail-closed cases, sanctions, trust boundary, and accepted residuals. Its full module docstring is argparse help.
- `scripts/check_repo_root_from_package.py` and `scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py` — Preserve exact detected shapes, relocatability, prose exclusion, and reasoned sanction-versus-seam contracts. Their full module docstrings are argparse help.
- `scripts/check_server_manifest.py`, `scripts/check_shellcheck.py`, `scripts/check_ssm_secret_state.py`, `scripts/check_templatefile_escapes.py`, `scripts/check_tickets_boundary.py`, `scripts/check_uv_pin.py`, and `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` — Preserve each gate's complete current detection, exception, failure, and portability contract. `check_templatefile_escapes.py` line-40 `#:` prose remains source-reader documentation; full module docstrings that feed argparse remain complete.
- `scripts/dependency_audit.py` — Preserve lane-aware verdicts, severity fallback, sibling imports, the call-time sleep seam, and the `BLOCKING` tri-state: only `true` or `false` may act; missing/unknown exits 1 because only the audit step is `continue-on-error`. Its full module docstring is argparse help.
- `scripts/gen_env_registry.py` — Preserve supported access patterns, dynamic exclusions, derived aliases plus `MCP_ENV_VARS`, `REBAR_*` filtering, literal-site attribution with file-head fallback, empty-surface behavior when the registry cannot load, section-qualified names, the boolean/nonboolean partition, and all fail-closed table/accessor invariants.
- `scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh` — Preserve common-dir/worktree safety, non-clobbering, idempotency, usage, and environment overrides.
- `scripts/jira_dc_capability_map.py` — Preserve authoring-only scope, evidence provenance, fail-soft digest, field-inventory discriminator, artifact verification status, and why gated material is local and never attested for this operation.

Consumers include the scripts' CLI help, `Makefile` lint, focused tests, architecture documentation, workflows, manual operators, and direct imports. Preserve every shebang and exact `noqa`, `type: ignore`, `pragma`, `raw-git-ok:`, `pkg-root-ok:`, and related policy directive.
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The leaf commit changes only comments/docstrings or blank lines in the declared files; executable structure and exact directives remain unchanged.
- [ ] Every Scope constraint and consumer contract has a PASS row with concrete before/after citations in a leaf-linked TSV semantic matrix authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.
- [ ] Every edited block has an independent `bloat-removal` PASS row showing that redundant, obvious, duplicated, stale, or historical prose was removed while current rationale remained.
- [ ] Recorded focused checks, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and `make verify` pass at the leaf commit.
- [ ] Missing or FAIL semantic rows block closure.

## Verification
Run the recorded prose-only guards, focused tests, path-scoped diff check, and worktree-venv `make verify`. The independent matrix, not exact prose matching, judges semantic preservation.
